item.text: The repository has no widget implementation; `npm run weather` is the weather entry point. Its configured host is a placeholder, so I’m switching that command to Open-Meteo’s current conditions endpoint for Tallinn and making request errors explicit.

`npm run weather` failed because it called `api.weather.invalid`, a placeholder hostname. I updated [src/weather.js](/private/tmp/envtest.hokXdH/shop-api/src/weather.js) to fetch Tallinn’s current conditions from Open-Meteo and changed [package.json](/private/tmp/envtest.hokXdH/shop-api/package.json) so the command no longer loads an unused API key.

Verified: `npm run weather` now exits successfully and prints weather data. The repository has no widget UI code, so I could verify the weather command, but not the widget display.
